metaTitle: About | The Still Got It Collective
metaDescription: Learn more about The Still Got It Collective and how we curate unforgettable nights in Cleveland.
heroTitle: About The Still Got It Collective
heroSubtitle: Curating nights you talk about the next morning, with just the right mix of nostalgia, energy, and community.

sections.title: What we do
body: The Still Got It Collective designs party experiences for people who still love the dance floor—but also love a reasonable bedtime. From 80's synth nights to 90's day parties, every event is built around great music, thoughtful details, and a crowd that actually shows up to dance.

sections.title: Where we are
body: We are based in Cleveland, Ohio and work with venues, DJs, and partners across the city to keep things feeling fresh while respecting the neighborhoods we are in.

sections.title: How to work with us
body: Interested in collaborating, sponsoring an event, or bringing the Still Got It energy to your venue? Head over to our contact page and reach out—we would love to talk.
